result.subject: Reminder: RSVP for Christmas party 2026
result.body:
Hi all,

Just a friendly nudge about our Christmas party 2026 on Friday 11 December at The Glasshouse, Shoreditch. If you haven’t responded yet, could you let us know by Friday 13 November whether you’ll be joining? The venue needs final numbers by Wednesday 18 November, so a quick yes or no (and any dietary or accessibility needs) would be great.

Thanks,
Business Operations
